tasks.subject: Task 0: norm() + LogicalIdentity in-memory normalization
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Shared norm() + normalized identity key so FAN SONG/Fan Song are the same LogicalIdentity (merge in memory), while raw values still drive the display name.

**Files:** Modify app/services/extraction_merge.py; Test tests/services/test_identity_norm.py (create)

**Acceptance Criteria:** norm trims/casefolds/collapses; case-variant LogicalIdentity == and hash-equal; identity_values_dict/identity_tuple stay RAW.

**Verify:** python3 -m pytest tests/services/test_identity_norm.py -v

tasks.subject: Task 3: One-time migration (merge pairs → backfill → index)
tasks.description:
**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** Destructive merge + graph-wide backfill on the live DB; close only after every acceptanceCriteria item is independently re-validated with captured output.

**Goal:** Bring the existing graph to the new scheme without re-ingest: merge 2 case-collisions, backfill _key on all existing domain vertices, then create the unique index.

**Files:** Create scripts/migrate_entity_key_dedup.py

**Acceptance Criteria:** 2 case-pairs merged (zero edges lost, 2 vertices removed); no null _key on any indexed domain vertex; _key UNIQUE index created; 16 Guideline variants still 16.

**Verify:** docker exec eip-mmdpp-api-1 python scripts/migrate_entity_key_dedup.py --dry-run (then live after user confirm) + Task 4 checks

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/migrate_entity_key_dedup.py"], "verifyCommand": "docker exec eip-mmdpp-api-1 python scripts/migrate_entity_key_dedup.py --dry-run", "acceptanceCriteria": ["2 case-pairs merged, zero edges lost", "no null _key on any indexed domain vertex", "_key unique index created", "16 Guideline variants still 16 vertices"], "userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"], "requiresUserSpecification": false, "gateScope": "migration", "modelTier": "complex"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Verification gate (dedup works, variants preserved)
tasks.description:
**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** Requested across two review rounds; close only after every acceptanceCriteria item is independently re-validated with captured output.

**Goal:** Prove case-dedup works end to end, existing data is clean, distinct variants preserved.

**Files:** Test tests/integration/test_entity_dedup.py

**Acceptance Criteria:** group by normalized key → fan song=1, spoon rest=1; merged Fan Song keeps specs + all EXTRACTED_FROM; 16 Guideline variants stay 16; no null _key; upsert FAN SONG hits existing vertex + edges resolve.

**Verify:** python3 -m pytest tests/integration/test_entity_dedup.py -v + captured graph queries
